label: Japanese
source_guidance: Interpret omitted Japanese subjects and the register of honorifics and self-reference. Read kanji compounds according to Japanese meaning. Source markers 〘…〙 contain furigana pronunciation hints: never include the markers or their kana contents in the translation.
target_guidance: Use natural Japanese fiction prose. Maintain the appropriate scope of plain/polite forms and each character’s self-reference. Do not add unsupported identity or gender information.
punctuation_rule: Use Japanese stops and commas (、。), dialogue quotes (「」『』) and punctuation conventions. Preserve symbol structure, repetition and pairing.
title_rule: Use conventional Japanese titles and section labels, such as 第3章, 序章 and エピローグ.
term_guidance: Copy reading only from kana explicitly given for the term in the Japanese source, such as furigana in 〘…〙 or an explicit reading explanation. Keep it in source-language kana, regardless of the target language. Do not infer a reading from kanji, a conventional name pronunciation or the translation. Leave reading empty when the source provides no reading.
reading_field: "reading":"Kana explicitly given in the Japanese source, or empty",
